note: Segments of the tiered investor report. The locked core is NOT here: it is in code and cannot be switched off. Edit defaults and tiers here; claim ids must exist in src/investor_tiers.js RULES; stat ids must exist in config/investor_stats.json.

segments.title: Market history
segments.evidence: REGISTER: Dubai Land Department sales register, dated counts and prices

segments.title: Comparable projects
segments.evidence: DERIVED from the sales register: same area, off-plan, 30 or more sales in the last 12 months

segments.title: Rent and yield estimate
segments.evidence: DERIVED from registered rent contracts and registered sale prices; method shown

segments.title: Neighbourhood facts
segments.evidence: REGISTER: nearest places as recorded on the sales register (straight line, not travel time)

segments.title: Dubai-wide figures
segments.evidence: REGISTER: Dubai Land Department sales register, whole city, same 12 months

segments.title: Price per sq ft by year
segments.evidence: DERIVED: yearly median price per sq ft of this project's registered sales

segments.title: Developer track record detail
segments.evidence: REGISTER for the registered company; brand-wide record matched by company name

segments.title: Amenities
segments.evidence: DEVELOPER_CLAIMED: the developer says; the register holds none of it

segments.title: Sales pace
segments.evidence: REGISTER: registered sales in the last 12 months

segments.title: Construction progress and handover
segments.evidence: REGISTER: project status, percent complete and planned end date

segments.title: Homes and prices by size
segments.evidence: REGISTER: unit register by number of bedrooms, and registered off-plan sales by size

segments.title: Homes coming in the area
segments.evidence: REGISTER: Dubai Land Department project register, all developers

segments.title: Buyer protections, in full evidence
segments.evidence: REGISTER: project registration, escrow bank and registered developer

segments.title: Payment plan and cash needed before handover
segments.evidence: DEVELOPER_CLAIMED plan (developer says) with a DERIVED cash figure, only when a plan and a price both exist

segments.title: Registered resale activity
segments.evidence: REGISTER: sale rows per month in this project and its district, by registered procedure

segments.title: Resale before handover: the conditions
segments.evidence: Only from a dated official rule card (none on file unless the config holds one); otherwise no rule is stated

segments.title: Residency and the project's prices
segments.evidence: REGISTER prices; the visa rule only from a dated official rule card (none on file unless the config holds one)
